profiles.notes: School-leaver and direct-entry rules. University pages do not give an intake year for these policies; accreditation and qualification registration do not confirm that applications are open.

requirements.label: BGCSE · subjects and grades
requirements.details: BIUST asks for credits in at least six subjects. It specifies mathematics at C or better, two science subjects and at least D in English. A* through C are credits; D is a pass. An English D alone does not count as one of the six credits.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: BGCSE · science and mathematics points
requirements.details: Accumulate at least 20 BIUST points from mathematics and the listed sciences (physics, chemistry, biology or the Science Double Award).

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: BGCSE · combined admission score
requirements.details: The published combined score must exceed 38 BIUST points across six subjects including English, mathematics and two sciences or double science. The double award receives double points; for example, AA contributes 16.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: BGCSE and IGCSE · local point conversion
requirements.details: BIUST admission points per subject (grade = points): A*,A = 8, B = 7, C = 6, D = 5, E = 4, F = 0.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: COSC, NSSC Ordinary Level, SGCSE, LGCSE and Senior Certificate Standard Grade
requirements.details: BIUST admission points per subject (grade = points): A = 8, B = 7, C = 6, D = 5, E = 4, F = 0.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: GCE A level / HSC · local point conversion
requirements.details: BIUST admission points per subject (grade = points): A = 12, B = 11, C = 10, D = 9, E = 8.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: GCE AS level and Senior Certificate Higher Grade · conversion
requirements.details: BIUST admission points per subject (grade = points): A = 10, B = 9, C = 8, D = 7, E = 6.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: National Senior Certificate · conversion
requirements.details: BIUST admission points per subject (grade = points): 7 = 10, 6 = 9, 5 = 8, 4 = 7, 3 = 6, 2 = 5, 1 = 4.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: Equivalence and programme selection
requirements.details: For qualifications outside the BGCSE route, BIUST assesses equivalence and the application individually. Selection depends on results, places and any additional degree requirements. The admissions office can confirm programme-specific conditions.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: One application and three ordered choices
requirements.details: Submit one complete application and rank up to three programme choices. BIUST considers their order. Send any change in writing to admissions@biust.ac.bw by the published application closing date.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate application procedure

requirements.label: School results and supporting evidence
requirements.details: Submit results for the relevant qualification and any applicable transcript with the form. An official results slip can be used temporarily; send the certificate when available. Documents in other languages need a certified English translation. Provide certified evidence for a change of name or other qualifications where applicable.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate application procedure

requirements.label: Application receipt and late submissions
requirements.details: BIUST issues an acknowledgement after submission. Incomplete applications are not processed. Review follows the closing date; a late application, if accepted, may not receive a decision in time for enrolment.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate application procedure

requirements.label: Qualification entry · NCQF
requirements.details: The registered Certificate IV (NCQF Level 4) or equivalent route requires passes in mathematics, physics, chemistry and English. The same subject combination appears in the chemical, mechanical and energy, and materials and metallurgical engineering specifications (Q0833, Q0835, Q0552).

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0833 · Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) in Chemical Engineering · p. 3

requirements.label: Qualification entry · NCQF
requirements.details: The registered entry qualification is Botswana NCQF Level 4 (Certificate IV or equivalent). Each programme’s linked specification identifies its entry route. The ecology and evolutionary biology honours specification explicitly lists school-level entry.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0737 · Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) in Computer and Telecommunications Engineering · p. 3

requirements.label: Qualification entry · NCQF
requirements.details: Certificate IV at NCQF Level 4 can be in general education or technical and vocational education and training. The listed qualifications have separate provision for recognition of prior learning or credit.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q1024 · Bachelor of Science in Earth and Environmental Sciences · pp. 3–4

requirements.label: Qualification entry · NCQF
requirements.details: The environmental and analytical chemistry BSc specifies chemistry, mathematics and one more science at Certificate IV level (general education or TVET), or an equivalent qualification.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0541 · Bachelor of Science in Chemistry (Environmental and Analytical Chemistry) · p. 5

requirements.label: Qualification entry · NCQF
requirements.details: For financial mathematics, use a related-field Level 4 Certificate IV in general education or TVET. Exemptions are assessed under the credit-transfer policy. Relevant industry experience may support alternative entry.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0593 · Bachelor of Science in Financial Mathematics · p. 3

requirements.label: Qualification entry · NCQF
requirements.details: The industrial mathematics honours specification accepts NCQF Level 4 in a related field. Credit-transfer or prior-learning exemptions are individually considered. A related Level 7 degree is a separate route.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0491 · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Industrial Mathematics · p. 3

profiles.notes: School-leaver and direct-entry rules. University pages do not give an intake year for these policies; accreditation and qualification registration do not confirm that applications are open.

requirements.label: International applicants · identity and qualifications
requirements.details: Provide certified copies of the secondary certificate or equivalent, valid passport and birth certificate. Include evidence of payment and certified additional qualifications or professional registration where applicable.

source.title: BIUST · international applicant documents and fees

requirements.label: International application fee · SADC residence
requirements.details: The posted fee is BWP 200 for residents of the Southern African Development Community and BWP 400 for non-SADC residents. Check the fee for the intake before paying.

source.title: BIUST · international applicant documents and fees

requirements.label: Qualifications from a non-English-speaking country
requirements.details: BIUST lists TOEFL iBT 60 or IELTS 5 when the qualification was obtained in a non-English-speaking country.

source.title: BIUST · international applicant documents and fees

profiles.notes: Advanced entry and progression. The route stated in each item distinguishes second-year admission from entry to an honours degree after earlier study.

requirements.label: Direct entry to year two · A levels
requirements.details: BIUST considers two or more A levels for second-year admission. Obtain C or better in mathematics and in one of physics, chemistry or biology.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: Direct entry to year two · BSc General
requirements.details: Complete the first BSc General year or equivalent at an accredited university. BIUST requires at least 40 BGCSE or equivalent points and a BSc transcript averaging at least 65%, without resits or retakes.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: Diploma applicants · advanced entry review
requirements.details: BIUST examines how closely the diploma matches the intended programme. Confirm the placement for the particular diploma.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: Advanced entry · possible admission examination
requirements.details: The university may request a pre-admission examination when assessing advanced entry.

source.title: BIUST · undergraduate entry and admission-point conversion

requirements.label: Qualification entry · NCQF
requirements.details: With a related bachelor’s degree at NCQF Level 7, the industrial mathematics honours qualification allows individually assessed exemptions under the credit-transfer or prior-learning policy.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0491 · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Industrial Mathematics · p. 3

requirements.label: Engineering · credit transfer
requirements.details: Civil and environmental engineering accepts prior-learning and credit applications where the credits are in comparable learning domains at a similar level to the programme.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0492 · Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) in Civil and Environmental Engineering · p. 2

requirements.label: Entry by prior learning or credit
requirements.details: The registered qualifications allow applicants to seek recognition of prior learning (RPL) or credit accumulation and transfer (CAT) under the provider’s rules. Ask BIUST to assess the evidence for the specific award.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0552 · Bachelor of Engineering Honours Materials and Metallugical Engineering · pp. 2–3

requirements.label: Mechatronics · prior learning
requirements.details: Mechatronics and industrial instrumentation explicitly recognises entry through prior learning. The published formal entry level is Certificate IV.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0764 · Bachelor of Engineering (Hons) Mechatronics and Industrial Instrumentation · p. 3

requirements.label: Alternative entry · relevant industry experience
requirements.details: Applicants outside the normal entry route who have relevant industry experience can request assessment under RPL and CAT. The reference specifications are Q0766 for mining, Q0753 for geological engineering and Q0541 for environmental and analytical chemistry.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0766 · Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) in Mining Engineering · p. 2

requirements.label: Honours entry · related first degree
requirements.details: Applicants to these honours degrees need a related NCQF Level 7 bachelor’s degree. For applied physics and data science the specification says the same or a cognate field; cybersecurity and digital forensics specifies a relevant degree.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0439 · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Applied Physics · p. 6

requirements.label: Information security management · first degree
requirements.details: The information security management honours qualification specifies a bachelor’s degree at NCQF Level 7. Prior learning or transferable credits may be considered.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0490 · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Information Security Management · p. 2

requirements.label: Honours in environmental and analytical chemistry
requirements.details: Present a bachelor’s degree in environmental and analytical chemistry, or its equivalent, for admission to the honours award.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0462 · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Chemistry (Environmental and Analytical Chemistry) · p. 4

requirements.label: Honours in drug discovery and development chemistry
requirements.details: Use a Level 7 bachelor’s degree in drug discovery and development chemistry, or a BSc in chemistry with an organic chemistry major or a cognate field.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0489 · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Chemistry (Drug Discovery and Development) · p. 3

requirements.label: Data science honours · alternative postgraduate awards
requirements.details: For data science honours, a postgraduate diploma or postgraduate certificate may also be considered. Prior learning and credit transfer are assessed under institutional policy.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0441 · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Data Science · pp. 2–3

requirements.label: Honours · relevant industry experience
requirements.details: The qualification allows applicants without the usual academic background to present relevant industry experience for assessment under RPL and CAT.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0489 · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Chemistry (Drug Discovery and Development) · p. 3

requirements.label: Applied physics honours · evidence for module recognition
requirements.details: An appointed assessor evaluates prior-learning evidence against the module or learning outcomes. Credit transfer follows the applicable CAT policy.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0439 · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Applied Physics · p. 11

requirements.label: Cybersecurity honours · alternative access
requirements.details: For cybersecurity and digital forensics honours, a candidate outside the formal degree route can be assessed under institutional and national prior-learning and credit-transfer policies.

source.title: Botswana Qualifications Authority · Q0438 · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Cyber Security and Digital Forensics · p. 3

requirements.label: Programme availability and registered qualification evidence
requirements.details: These additional awards appear in BQA’s accredited programme list for BIUST. Check application availability and the intended entry route directly with BIUST for the relevant intake.
